title_en: Sign in with the Ebda AI Studio account
merchant_questions_en: How do I sign in to Ebda Chat?
steps: Use the same Ebda AI Studio account as Ebda Store
You land in the inbox for your store
edge_cases: Sign-in error codes: denied, state, nonce, token, discovery, missing_id_token, claims (SignInError screen lists a reason)
gaps: No help article for sign-in problems
assistant_note: Assistant can explain only; it never handles credentials

title_en: Sync templates and review status from Meta
merchant_questions_en: My template status did not update, how do I sync?
steps: API only: no caller in web or cron (no periodic sync)
Status also updates via webhook message_template_status_update
edge_cases: Meta unreachable or rate-limited: 503 rate_limited, retry shortly; nothing is lost
gaps: NO caller (audit #2): nothing triggers sync on connect or periodically
Staff may call it (no owner check)
assistant_note: full replace: absent templates are deleted locally

screen: none (inbox picker and CampaignForm list only APPROVED)
steps: No templates page: approved ones appear in the chat template picker and the campaign form
edge_cases: Empty list for an own-number merchant until templates are submitted by API
gaps: NO merchant Templates screen (help 04 describes one that does not exist)
Status and rejectedReason exist in TemplateDto but no screen renders them for merchants

title_en: Connect the agent to your own systems (webhook / Odoo)
merchant_questions_en: Can the agent call my own system or Odoo?
steps: API only: kind webhook or odoo, https:443 only, HMAC-signed calls, secret write-only, one test per 5 s
gaps: NO merchant UI and NO merchant help article
assistant_note: gives the agent tool access to external systems

title_en: Template approval, rejection and category-change updates (webhook)
title_ar: تحديث حالة القالب تلقائي من ميتا
merchant_questions_ar: ازاي تحديث حالة القالب تلقائي من ميتا؟
merchant_questions_en: When will Meta review my template?
steps: Meta pushes APPROVED/REJECTED/PAUSED/DISABLED with reason; stored on the template
edge_cases: Approval takes minutes to about a day
gaps: Status is not shown to merchants anywhere

title_en: Create and submit a template to Meta (own WABA)
plan_gate: package in good standing + active number
merchant_questions_ar: عايز اعمل رسالة بلغ بيها العميل إن الأوردر اتشحن
merchant_questions_en: How do I create a message template?
steps: Today: raw API only (name [a-z0-9_], language, category MARKETING/UTILITY/AUTHENTICATION, BODY required)
Planned: Templates screen + assistant template-writer (spec section 6.7)
edge_cases: Meta may require example values for variables; our schema is permissive so Meta may reject (unverified)
assistant_note: a submission to Meta on the merchant account; cannot be withdrawn, edit not supported by our API

steps: Pick warm / professional / playful; added to the reply style

title_en: Review InstaPay proofs (view, confirm, release hold, reject)

merchant_questions_en: Why can I not do this myself: Review InstaPay proofs (view, confirm, release hold, reject)?
steps: Super admin only; every write re-checks the session (fails closed) and is audited with actor and reason
edge_cases: Assistant refuses and offers the merchant-facing alternative or a handoff to Ebda
gaps: Self-service gap: BLOCKER #4: confirmation should become AI auto-confirm when the receipt matches (spec 7.4), human only on flags; duplicate/hold release stays human (fraud)
